name: Edu Craft
description: Teaching and knowledge-product chain: learning-contract-driven course design with checkpoint breakdown, strict exercise generation (open-ended questions, MCQ banned, rubric included), and a Feynman loop explainer (diagnose, repair, teach-back, transfer). Topic in, mastery-ready course kit out.
description_zh: 教学与知识产品链条：学习契约驱动的课程设计（checkpoint 分解）、严格习题生成（开放题防蒙、附评分标准）、费曼循环讲解器（诊断→修复→回讲→迁移）。主题进、可交付掌握式课程包出。方法论借鉴费曼学习法生态与掌握式学习实践并已署名。
